pattern.short_summary: The system marks particular locations inside the user's content and attaches a deeper layer of material to each mark that is not shown until the user asks for it.
pattern.definition: The system marks particular locations inside the user's content and attaches a deeper layer of material to each mark that is not shown until the user asks for it. The first layer is a lightweight in-content indicator; the second is an expandable panel, popup, or tab bar holding explanation, alternatives, or scores. Detail is thus staged rather than presented all at once.
pattern.structural_signature: Per-unit annotations are rendered inline at their source location; each annotation is an interactive trigger (hover, click, expand) that opens a secondary container holding additional per-unit material. Collapsing the container returns the display to the marked-but-undetailed state, so the content view never carries the full detail at rest.

dimension.category_description: How evidence, internals, correspondence, quality, interpretations, and planned actions are represented for human judgment.
dimension.classification_boundary: The representation must support understanding or verification, rather than merely render output into a usable medium.
